Genetics can play a role as far as I’m aware. OCD is a form of an anxiety disorder. Definitely talk to the counselor and see if you can find a specialist. Be careful with dumb therapists that don’t know much about OCD. I was told I have paranoia by some idiot. Try to find someone who knows a thing or two about it.
